SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE.description: Metadata cannot be read from the configured source database.
SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE.recommendation: Restore the read-only connection and credentials, then rescan before approving schema changes.

OWNERSHIP_REVIEW.description: The runtime owner and disposition of this discovered asset have not been decided.
OWNERSHIP_REVIEW.recommendation: Assign a runtime owner and record an activate, consolidate, or retire decision through a versioned migration.

MISSING_PRIMARY_KEY.description: The logical table has no stable row identity.
MISSING_PRIMARY_KEY.recommendation: Check duplicate rows and downstream contracts before adding a primary key.

MISSING_DOCUMENTATION.description: The source catalog and Provider annotation have no business description.
MISSING_DOCUMENTATION.recommendation: Document purpose, ownership, retention, and tenant boundary before the next review.

TIMEZONE_AMBIGUITY.description: Some timestamp columns have no defined time-zone semantics.
TIMEZONE_AMBIGUITY.recommendation: Define a UTC conversion contract and migrate to timestamptz in a compatibility release.

UNINDEXED_FOREIGN_KEY.description: No leading index was found for this foreign-key lookup.
UNINDEXED_FOREIGN_KEY.recommendation: Validate delete and join plans, then add a leading index where the relationship carries operational load.

DUPLICATE_FOREIGN_KEY.description: More than one foreign-key constraint enforces the same column relationship.
DUPLICATE_FOREIGN_KEY.recommendation: Keep one canonical constraint and remove duplicates through a versioned migration.

ANNOTATION_DRIFT.description: An asset registered in Provider annotations is absent from the live source catalog.
ANNOTATION_DRIFT.recommendation: Check the source connection and rename mapping, or retire the stale annotation.

LINEAGE_DRIFT.description: A registered data-flow source or target is absent from the live source catalog.
LINEAGE_DRIFT.recommendation: Confirm the owning process, then repair or retire the lineage contract.

relationships.guidance: Only live foreign keys in {{database}} are shown. Dashed edges have no leading index and require query-plan review.

lineage.guidance: These are cross-service contracts such as provisioning and event delivery that cannot be expressed as database foreign keys. Animated edges are asynchronous event flows.
